groups.name: Party House
groups.description: If you can remember who won, you weren't playing hard enough.

games.notes: First race night. Nick out front immediately.
Jeff steals one. Nick was NOT happy.
Sarah comes out of nowhere. Chaos race.
Nick on a tear. 5 wins total in MK.
Jeff finally gets his Smash win.
Closest game yet. Jeff wins in OT.
Jeff runs it back.
Nick goes nuclear. Blowout.
Marcus goes off. Nobody could stop him.
2v2. Clean teamwork from Nick and Marcus.
1v3 handicap match. Jeff said give him 3. He won.
3v2 to balance skill levels. Worked perfectly.
First party night. Jeff and Sarah on fire.
Nick finally gets one back.
1v3 Beer Pong. Jeff said hold his drink. Literally.
2v3 Flip Cup. Jeff and Nick handle it easily.
Nick gets revenge on the Flip Cup table.
Priya absolutely demolished everyone.
Marcus survives to the end somehow.
Close one. Nick and Marcus grind it out.
Sarah has the steadiest hands in the group. Again.
